_doc: Parity gate contract. ratio = python_time / go_time at reference_scale; r_min is the minimum acceptable ratio. A workload passes when best measured ratio >= r_min AND (where baseline < regression_check_ceiling) has not regressed below baseline by more than tolerance. r_min seeded at 0.65x the measured ratio to absorb Python-side run-to-run variance on a shared machine; the ratio conflates Go time (controlled) with Python time (noisy), so the gate's strongest guarantee is the absolute r_min floor. Re-seed this file and parity_baseline.json from the same run when committing a new top30_summary.json, ideally on a quiescent machine. r_min<1.0 requires justification; out_of_scope excluded.

DataFrame/drop_nulls.justification: Polars runs this op multi-threaded over chunked Arrow; gopolars now parallelizes the null scan and shards the per-column gather across all cores, but the gather is memory-bandwidth-bound and the string column's Go-pointer storage forces GC write barriers that Polars' byte-layout avoids, so it floors at the measured 1M ratio. Ratchet upward as the path improves.
